name: working-from-lenny
description: Eleven PM tools drawn from the Lenny's Newsletter and How I AI corpora. Each tool returns a corpus-grounded brief; the host chat model renders the user-facing narration.
long_description: Eleven small tools (quiz-and-narration apps, paste-and-critique apps, wizard apps, and rehearsal apps) built on a current-consensus knowledge base over Lenny Rachitsky's newsletter and podcast plus Claire Vo's How I AI show. Tools return structured 'narration briefs' (corpus chunks + picks + voice rules + structure); the host chat model renders the user-facing prose. State for the few stateful tools lives in the bundle's local data dir; no remote storage.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_get_questions
tools.description: Returns the canonical 20 PM-pitfall questions. Host MUST render these exact questions (or the ui://working-from-lenny/pitfalls resource) before collecting answers; the score is positional.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_score
tools.description: Scores the user's audit and persists the corpus-grounded narration brief for chat-side rendering. AFTER calling score, render the user's personalized narration by calling pm_pitfalls_get_pending_narration.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_narrate
tools.description: Packages a corpus-grounded narration brief for the user's top three pitfalls. Pure compute — no persistence. The embedded UI and chat-side Claude don't normally need this directly; call pm_pitfalls_get_pending_narration to retrieve the brief score already saved.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_drift
tools.description: Stateful. Returns the user's calibration drift across re-audits. Persists answers locally between runs.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_get_pending_narration
tools.description: MUST CALL whenever the user asks for their PM Pitfalls 'personalized read', 'narration', or follow-up to an audit just taken — including messages from the embedded widget. Do NOT respond 'you haven't taken the audit' without calling this tool first; the audit state lives on disk, not in chat history.

tools.name: pm_horoscope_get_quiz
tools.description: Returns the six-question PM Horoscope archetype quiz and triggers the host to mount the ui://working-from-lenny/horoscope iframe. Use this to discover the user's archetype; if they already know it, call pm_horoscope_read instead.

tools.name: pm_horoscope_score_quiz
tools.description: Scores the six-question archetype quiz and persists today's horoscope brief. AFTER calling score_quiz, render the user's personalized reading by calling pm_horoscope_get_pending_narration.

tools.name: pm_horoscope_read
tools.description: Fetches today's PM Horoscope reading for a known archetype slug and persists the corpus-grounded narration brief. AFTER calling read, render the user's personalized reading by calling pm_horoscope_get_pending_narration.

tools.name: pm_horoscope_narrate
tools.description: Packages a corpus-grounded narration brief for an archetype's daily horoscope reading. Pure compute — no persistence. The embedded UI and chat-side Claude don't normally need this directly; call pm_horoscope_get_pending_narration to retrieve the brief score_quiz or read already saved.

tools.name: pm_horoscope_get_pending_narration
tools.description: MUST CALL whenever the user asks for their PM Horoscope 'personalized reading', 'narration', or follow-up to a quiz or archetype pick — including messages from the embedded widget. Do NOT respond 'you haven't picked an archetype' without calling this tool first; the audit state lives on disk, not in chat history.
